name: Deep return strokes against a wall
summary: Alone at a wall, drop-feed and hit a full return-of-serve stroke above a tape line, then step forward as after a return.
setup: Tape a line on the wall about 1.5 m above the floor (well above net height)
Stand about 6 m from the wall; drop the ball, let it bounce, and hit a full, smooth forehand or backhand return above the line
After each stroke take two steps forward, as after a return, then walk back to the start
Sets of 10 strokes; count strokes that hit the wall above the line
success_criterion: In each of 3 sets of 10 strokes, at least 8 hit the wall above the tape line
coach_rationale: (judgment) A high, deep return gives the receiving side time to reach the non-volley-zone line, which supports winning rallies on receive (AN-02); a wall lets a player groove the stroke alone and with no court. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
